panels.title: Avg duration by stage
panels.description: Average phases_summary.<stage>.duration_ms across all request_trace events (90d, full history -- 794 requests, 2026-04-23 to 2026-06-07). llm_inference dominates (avg 24.9s), then tool_execution (avg 5.4s); setup/persistence/synthesis are negligible (<1s each). STALE SIGNAL: request_trace has emitted zero documents since 2026-06-07 (24+ days as of this build) -- this instrumentation has gone dark with no replacement found. This panel answers the stage-breakdown decision for the period it was live, not for current behavior. See the sibling Request volume over time panel, where the same cutoff is directly visible.

panels.title: Turn duration p50/p95 (Tempo span duration)
panels.description: FRE-1072 AC-4: per-day p50/p95 turn duration from Tempo span duration alone (TraceQL quantile_over_time) -- no union with any Elasticsearch field. This is deliberately the single duration source for this dashboard going forward: span duration is intrinsic to Tempo (no second field to union), and it replaces the sibling 'Total request duration over time' ES panel's total_duration_ms field, which this same dashboard's own history already flags as stale (the request_trace event stopped emitting on 2026-06-07). That ES panel is kept for its historical range; this one is the live signal.
